title: EncryptedEnvelopeV1
description: Version-one wire envelope for an encrypted note exchanged between the sender and the desktop companion. See protocol/README.md for the full specification.

protocolVersion.description: Must be exactly 1 for this version of the protocol.

messageId.description: Canonical lowercase UUID, as produced by crypto.randomUUID().

createdUtc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp with a 'Z' suffix. Used verbatim (not normalized) as part of the AAD, so the wire string must be preserved exactly.

deliverAfterUtc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp with a 'Z' suffix, or null. Used verbatim as part of the AAD.

ephemeralPublicKey.description: Unpadded Base64URL encoding of a fresh P-256 SPKI DER public key (91 bytes decoded), generated once per envelope.

hkdfSalt.description: Unpadded Base64URL encoding of 32 random bytes used as the HKDF-SHA-256 salt.

nonce.description: Unpadded Base64URL encoding of the 12-byte random AES-256-GCM nonce.

ciphertext.description: Unpadded Base64URL encoding of AES-256-GCM ciphertext with the 16-byte (128-bit) authentication tag appended (ciphertext‖tag). Decoded length must be between 17 and 6144 bytes inclusive.
